<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<meta name="description" content="Divya Classes - Mathematics and Science coaching for Classes 9 and 10 at Chalki, Daulatpur, Begusarai.">
<title>Divya Classes | Maths & Science | Classes 9 & 10</title>
<style>
:root{--navy:#07386b;--blue:#0879e8;--teal:#078c91;--gold:#f5b91f;--green:#12a66a;--red:#e53935;--ink:#10243d;--muted:#62758b;--bg:#f4f9fd;--card:#fff}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);line-height:1.55}a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}button,input,select{font:inherit}
.container{width:min(1180px,93%);margin:auto}.top{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #dbe8f3;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;box-shadow:0 3px 20px #07386b12}
.toprow{min-height:78px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px}.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.brand img{width:58px;height:58px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:50%}.brand h1{font-size:24px;color:var(--navy);margin:0;line-height:1}.brand p{margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--teal);font-weight:800;font-size:12px}
.director{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px}.director b{display:block;color:var(--navy)}.director a{color:var(--blue);font-weight:800}
.cbse-top{width:58px;height:58px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--teal);margin-left:10px}.menu{display:none;border:0;background:transparent;font-size:28px;color:var(--navy)}
.nav{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}.navinner{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;overflow:auto}.nav a{padding:12px 15px;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap}.nav a:hover{background:#0b5a9d}
.hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#063f67,#087d8b 60%,#0b5b9c);color:#fff;padding:48px 0}.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr .7fr;gap:30px;align-items:center}
.hero h2{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,62px);line-height:1.03;margin:0 0 14px}.hero h2 span{color:#ffe064}.hero p{font-size:18px;color:#e8f8ff;max-width:700px}.hero-pills{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;margin:20px 0}.pill{padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffffff1a;border:1px solid #ffffff35;font-weight:800}
.btn{border:0;border-radius:11px;padding:12px 17px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;display:inline-block}.primary{background:#0879e8;color:#fff}.gold{background:var(--gold);color:#17324d}.light{background:#fff;color:var(--navy)}.danger{background:#d92d2d;color:#fff}
.hero-card{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-radius:22px;padding:20px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 18px 50px #001c3038}.hero-card img{width:210px;height:210px;object-fit:contain}.hero-card strong{color:var(--navy);font-size:20px}.hero-card small{color:var(--muted);display:block}

section{padding:58px 0}.heading{text-align:center;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto 30px}.heading h2{color:var(--navy);font-size:32px;margin:0 0 7px}.heading p{color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.features{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:15px}.feature{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dbe8f3;border-radius:17px;padding:20px;text-align:center}.feature .ico{font-size:30px}.feature h3{color:var(--navy);margin:8px 0 4px;font-size:17px}.feature p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.youtube{background:#fff2f2}.youtube-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #ffd4d4;border-radius:20px;padding:25px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;justify-content:space-between}.yt-icon{width:68px;height:48px;background:#f00;border-radius:12px;color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:25px}.youtube-card h3{margin:0;color:#9b1414}.youtube-card p{color:var(--muted);margin:4px 0}

.test{background:#eaf6ff}.test-box{background:#fff;border:1px solid #d7e7f3;border-radius:22px;padding:25px;box-shadow:0 12px 35px #07386b0d}.controls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr .7fr 1fr 1fr;gap:12px}.field label{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);display:block;margin-bottom:5px}.field input,.field select{width:100%;border:1px solid #cbddea;border-radius:9px;padding:11px;background:#fff}
.question{border-top:1px solid #e4edf5;padding:20px 0}.question:first-child{border-top:0}.qtitle{font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);font-size:16px}.tag{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;background:#eaf4ff;color:var(--blue);padding:3px 7px;border-radius:999px;margin-left:6px}.option{display:block;background:#f7fbff;border:1px solid #e4eef6;padding:9px 10px;border-radius:9px;margin:7px 0;cursor:pointer}.option:hover{background:#edf7ff}.question-img{margin:12px 0;background:#f5fbff;border:1px solid #dcecf7;border-radius:12px;padding:10px;text-align:center}.question-img svg{max-width:100%;height:170px}.test-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:15px}.result{display:none;margin-top:20px;border-radius:16px;padding:20px;background:#ecfbf3;border:1px solid #c6ead6}.score{font-size:34px;font-weight:1000;color:var(--green)}.weak{color:#8a5600;font-weight:800}.motivate{font-weight:800;color:var(--navy)}

.results{background:#fff}.summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;margin-bottom:20px}.sum{background:#f5faff;border:1px solid #dbe9f5;border-radius:16px;padding:18px;text-align:center}.sum b{display:block;font-size:28px;color:var(--blue)}.sum span{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dbe8f3;border-radius:20px;padding:22px;margin-top:18px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #07386b0a}.panel h3{margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--navy)}.tablewrap{overflow:auto}.table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:760px}.table th,.table td{padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #e5edf4;text-align:left}.table th{background:#eef7ff;color:var(--navy);font-size:13px}.rank{font-weight:900;color:var(--blue)}
.good{background:#ddf8ea;color:#11643e;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:900;font-size:12px}.needs{background:#fff0d7;color:#8a5600;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:900;font-size:12px}
.cbse-section{background:#f2fbfb}.cbse-box{display:flex;gap:22px;align-items:center;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d5ebeb;border-radius:20px;padding:22px}.cbse-box img{width:115px;height:115px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px}.cbse-box h3{color:var(--navy);margin:0 0 6px}.cbse-box p{color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.contact{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}.contact h2{color:#fff}.contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}.contact-card{background:#ffffff12;border:1px solid #ffffff24;border-radius:18px;padding:22px}.contact-card h3{margin-top:0}.contact-card p{color:#dbeaff}
footer{background:#041f3d;color:#bcd1e6;padding:25px 0}.foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;flex-wrap:wrap}footer strong{color:#fff}


/* DIVYA KNOWLEDGE CHAMPIONSHIP CERTIFICATES */
.cert-section{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f8fbff,#eef6ff)}
.cert-info{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;margin-bottom:20px}.cert-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dbe8f3;border-radius:20px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #07386b0a}.cert-card h3{color:var(--navy);margin:0 0 8px}.cert-card p{color:var(--muted);margin:6px 0}.cert-status{font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);margin-top:12px}.cert-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}.certificate-preview{margin-top:20px;display:none}.certificate-sheet{width:100%;max-width:1100px;margin:auto;aspect-ratio:1.414/1;background:#fffdf5;border:12px solid #07386b;outline:4px solid #f5b91f;outline-offset:-22px;position:relative;padding:70px 90px;color:#07386b;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 18px 50px #07386b22}.certificate-sheet:before,.certificate-sheet:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:180px;height:180px;border:5px solid #f5b91f;border-radius:50%;opacity:.22}.certificate-sheet:before{left:-100px;top:-100px}.certificate-sheet:after{right:-100px;bottom:-100px}.cert-ribbon{display:inline-block;background:#07386b;color:#fff;padding:13px 35px;border:4px solid #f5b91f;border-radius:8px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:clamp(18px,3vw,32px);box-shadow:0 7px 0 #b9850b}.cert-title{font-size:clamp(24px,4vw,48px);font-weight:1000;text-align:center;margin:18px 0 8px}.cert-subtitle{text-align:center;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(18px,2.5vw,34px);margin-bottom:24px}.cert-name{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,52px);font-weight:900;text-align:center;border-bottom:3px solid #07386b;display:block;max-width:760px;margin:15px auto;padding:10px 12px;color:#10243d}.cert-body{text-align:center;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(14px,1.6vw,22px);line-height:1.7;max-width:850px;margin:auto}.cert-footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-top:40px;font-weight:800;text-align:center}.cert-footer div{min-width:180px;border-top:2px solid #07386b;padding-top:7px}.cert-seal{position:absolute;left:55px;top:210px;width:125px;height:125px;border-radius:50%;border:7px double #f5b91f;background:#07386b;color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;font-weight:1000;font-size:20px;transform:rotate(-10deg)}.cert-medal{position:absolute;right:55px;top:205px;width:125px;height:125px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#f5b91f 0 58%,#9b6d00 59% 67%,#fff 68% 72%,#07386b 73%);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:40px;font-weight:1000;color:#07386b}.cert-note{background:#fff8df;border:1px solid #f5d978;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;margin-top:14px;color:#765500;font-size:13px}
@media(max-width:850px){.cert-info{grid-template-columns:1fr}.certificate-sheet{padding:45px 35px}.cert-seal,.cert-medal{display:none}.cert-footer{margin-top:25px}.cert-ribbon{font-size:16px;padding:10px 18px}}

@media(max-width:850px){
 .director{display:none}.menu{display:block;margin-left:auto}.toprow{min-height:68px}.brand h1{font-size:19px}.brand img{width:48px;height:48px}.cbse-top{width:48px;height:48px}
 .navinner{display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;padding:8px}.navinner.open{display:flex}.nav a{display:block}
 .hero-grid,.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.features{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.controls{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.summary{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.youtube-card{flex-wrap:wrap}.cbse-box{align-items:flex-start}
}
@media(max-width:520px){.features,.controls,.summary{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{padding:35px 0}.hero-card img{width:170px;height:170px}.youtube-card{display:block}.yt-icon{margin-bottom:12px}.btn{width:100%;text-align:center}.test-actions .btn{width:100%}}

/* Added: Maths & Science attraction + CBSE pattern paper */
.subject-focus{background:#f7fbff}.subject-focus-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}.subject-focus-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dbe8f3;border-radius:20px;padding:24px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #07386b0a}.subject-focus-card h3{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--navy);font-size:22px}.subject-focus-card p{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 12px}.focus-list{margin:0;padding-left:20px;color:var(--ink)}.focus-list li{margin:7px 0}.cbse-pattern{background:#eef8ff}.pattern-box{background:#fff;border:1px solid #d7e7f3;border-radius:22px;padding:24px;box-shadow:0 12px 35px #07386b0d}.pattern-controls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}.pattern-question{border-top:1px solid #e4edf5;padding:20px 0}.pattern-question:first-child{border-top:0}.pattern-qhead{font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:9px}.pattern-type{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;background:#eaf4ff;color:var(--blue);padding:3px 8px;border-radius:999px;margin-right:7px}.pattern-option{display:block;background:#f7fbff;border:1px solid #e4eef6;padding:9px 10px;border-radius:9px;margin:7px 0;cursor:pointer}.pattern-answer{width:100%;min-height:90px;border:1px solid #cbddea;border-radius:10px;padding:11px;resize:vertical}.paper-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}.monthly-box{margin-top:18px;background:#ecfbf3;border:1px solid #c6ead6;border-radius:16px;padding:16px}.monthly-box b{color:var(--green);font-size:25px}.cbse-note{margin-top:18px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d5ebeb;border-radius:16px;padding:15px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.cbse-official{color:var(--teal);font-weight:900}
@media(max-width:850px){.subject-focus-grid,.pattern-controls{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.cbse-set-badge{display:inline-block;margin:10px 0;padding:8px 13px;border-radius:999px;background:#eaf4ff;color:var(--blue);font-weight:900;font-size:13px}.pattern-answer{width:100%;min-height:90px;border:1px solid #cbddea;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;resize:vertical}.sample-paper-panel{border:1px solid #d7e6f3}.sample-head{padding:4px 0}.sample-head h3{margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--blue)}.paper-preview .panel{padding:18px}.paper-preview h4{color:var(--blue);margin:18px 0 8px}.notice{padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;background:#f4f9ff;border-left:4px solid var(--blue);line-height:1.55}
/* ADMIN FILE MANAGER - added without changing existing sections */
.admin-fab{display:none;position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:9998;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:#07386b;color:#fff;padding:12px 16px;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 8px 24px #07386b44;cursor:pointer}
.admin-fab:hover{background:#0879e8}
.admin-modal{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:#001c3070;z-index:9999;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px}
.admin-modal.show{display:flex}
.admin-box{width:min(620px,100%);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px #001c3055}
.admin-box h2{margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--navy)}
.admin-box .admin-muted{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.admin-row{margin:14px 0}.admin-row label{display:block;font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px}
.admin-row input{width:100%;border:1px solid #cbddea;border-radius:9px;padding:11px;background:#fff}
.admin-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}
.admin-list{margin-top:18px;border-top:1px solid #e3edf5}.admin-file{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #e3edf5}
.admin-file-name{font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);overflow-wrap:anywhere}.admin-file-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.admin-status{margin-top:12px;padding:10px;border-radius:10px;background:#f4f9ff;color:var(--navy);font-size:13px;display:none}
.admin-status.show{display:block}
@media(max-width:520px){.admin-fab{right:10px;bottom:10px}.admin-box{padding:17px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- Admin File Manager -->
<div id="adminModal" class="admin-modal" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="admin-box" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="adminTitle">
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center">
      <div><h2 id="adminTitle">Admin File Manager</h2><div class="admin-muted">Only the authenticated admin can upload, replace or delete files.</div></div>
      <button class="btn light" type="button" onclick="closeAdminManager()">✕</button>
    </div>
    <div id="adminLoginArea">
      <div class="admin-row"><label for="adminEmail">Admin email</label><input id="adminEmail" type="email" autocomplete="username" placeholder="admin@example.com"></div>
      <div class="admin-row"><label for="adminPassword">Admin password</label><input id="adminPassword" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="Password"></div>
      <div class="admin-actions"><button class="btn primary" type="button" onclick="adminLogin()">Login</button></div>
    </div>
    <div id="adminPanel" style="display:none">
      <div class="admin-row"><label for="adminFile">Choose any file to upload</label><input id="adminFile" type="file"></div>
      <div class="admin-actions">
        <button class="btn primary" type="button" onclick="adminUpload()">⬆ Upload / Replace</button>
        <button class="btn light" type="button" onclick="adminRefreshFiles()">↻ Refresh files</button>
        <button class="btn danger" type="button" onclick="adminLogout()">Logout</button>
      </div>
      <div id="adminStatus" class="admin-status"></div>
      <div id="adminFiles" class="admin-list"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="director"><div><b>Director: R. Kumar</b><a href="tel:9523101684">📞 9523101684</a></div><img class="cbse-top" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="CBSE Pattern"></div>
